reasoning.overall: Bayern host PSG at the Allianz Arena trailing 4-5 from a record-breaking first leg in Paris. They must win by 2+ goals in 90 minutes or by 1 with extra time to advance. Bayern are slight favorites given home advantage, an in-form Kane (12 UCL goals, 53 in all comps), aggressive front-foot pressing, and PSG's confirmed loss of right-back Achraf Hakimi (hamstring tear) plus a doubt over Vitinha (heel). The first-leg xG (2.51 vs 1.91) suggests Bayern were the better chance-creating side and converted poorly; at home with desperation to chase the tie they should generate similar volume. Both teams have scored 38+ UCL goals this campaign — the most prolific in the competition. Expect another open, high-scoring match with goals in both halves.
